digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport outbound assignee sync
propositions: Outbound assignee clear sends empty string instead of None to the DC transport, reaching client.update_issue(assignee="")
JiraDataCenterTransport._assign passes empty string verbatim to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue without converting falsy values to None
pycontribs JIRA library only recognizes None as unassign sentinel; empty string triggers search_users which either raises error or assigns arbitrary user
Cloud transport already implements correct fix by routing empty/None assignee through unassign_issue; DC transport never received this half
Fix maps falsy assignee to None in DC transport._assign before calling assign_issue, allowing pycontribs to PUT {"name": null} for unassign
